lines.text: 옛날 어느 성에 금빛 공을 가장 좋아하는 공주가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a princess who loved her golden ball more than anything.
segs: Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a princess who loved her golden ball more than anything.

lines.text: 금공은 어떤 모양일까요? 골라 봐요.
lines.en: What shape is the golden ball? Pick one!
segs: What shape is the golden ball? Pick one!

lines.text: 그건 네모예요. 금공 모양을 다시 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's a square. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
segs: That's a square. Find the shape of the golden ball again.

lines.text: 그건 세모예요. 금공 모양을 다시 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's a triangle. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
segs: That's a triangle. Find the shape of the golden ball again.

lines.text: 맞아요, 동그라미! 금공은 동글동글 동그라미예요.
lines.en: That's right, a circle! The golden ball is round like a circle.
segs: That's right, a circle! The golden ball is round like a circle.

lines.text: 통통통! 내 금공은 세상에서 제일 예뻐.
lines.en: Bounce, bounce! My golden ball is the prettiest in the whole world.
segs: Bounce, bounce! My golden ball is the prettiest in the whole world.

lines.text: 어느 날, 공주는 숲속 샘가에서 공놀이를 했어요.
lines.en: One day, the princess played with her ball beside a spring in the forest.
segs: One day, the princess played with her ball beside a spring in the forest.

lines.text: 공이 높이, 더 높이… 어머나!
lines.en: The ball went up high, and higher... oh my!
segs: The ball went up high, and higher... oh my!

lines.text: 공이 샘 속으로 풍덩! 금공이 깊은 물속으로 가라앉았어요.
lines.en: Splash! The ball fell into the spring and sank deep down into the water.
segs: Splash! The ball fell into the spring and sank deep down into the water.

lines.text: 엉엉, 내 금공… 내 금공이 사라졌어.
lines.en: Boo-hoo, my golden ball... my golden ball is gone.
segs: Boo-hoo, my golden ball... my golden ball is gone.

lines.text: 그때 샘물 위로 초록 개구리가 고개를 내밀었어요.
lines.en: Just then, a green frog poked his head up out of the water.
segs: Just then, a green frog poked his head up out of the water.

lines.text: 공주님, 왜 울어요?
lines.en: Princess, why are you crying?

lines.text: 내 금공이 샘에 빠졌어. 흑흑.
lines.en: My golden ball fell into the spring. Sniff, sniff.
segs: My golden ball fell into the spring. Sniff, sniff.

lines.text: 내가 공을 찾아 줄게. 대신 나랑 친구가 되고, 같이 먹고, 한 침대에서 자 줄래?
lines.en: I'll get your ball for you. But in return, will you be my friend, eat with me, and let me sleep in your bed?
segs: I'll get your ball for you. But in return, will you be my friend, eat with me, and let me sleep in your bed?

lines.text: 좋아, 약속할게!
lines.en: Okay, I promise!

lines.text: 개구리는 풍덩 물속으로 들어가 금공을 물고 올라왔어요.
lines.en: The frog dived into the water, splash, and came back up with the golden ball in his mouth.
segs: The frog dived into the water, splash, and came back up with the golden ball in his mouth.

lines.text: 내 공이다!
lines.en: My ball!

lines.text: 공주는 공을 받아 안고 성으로 쌩 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The princess grabbed the ball and ran straight home to the castle.
segs: The princess grabbed the ball and ran straight home to the castle.

lines.text: 기다려, 약속했잖아!
lines.en: Wait! You promised!

lines.text: 저녁 식사 때, 문 밖에서 폴짝폴짝 소리가 났어요. 똑똑!
lines.en: At supper time, there came a hop, hop sound outside the door. Knock, knock!
segs: At supper time, there came a hop, hop sound outside the door. Knock, knock!

lines.text: 공주님, 약속했잖아요. 문 좀 열어 줘요.
lines.en: Princess, you promised. Please open the door.
segs: Princess, you promised. Please open the door.

lines.text: 싫어! 저리 가!
lines.en: No! Go away!

lines.text: 그 모습을 본 임금님이 공주에게 물었어요.
lines.en: The king saw this and asked the princess.
segs: The king saw this and asked the princess.

lines.text: 공주야, 무슨 약속을 했느냐?
lines.en: My princess, what did you promise?
segs: My princess, what did you promise?

lines.text: 개구리가 금공을 찾아 주면… 친구가 되겠다고 했어요.
lines.en: I said that if the frog found my golden ball... I would be his friend.
segs: I said that if the frog found my golden ball... I would be his friend.

lines.text: 약속은 지켜야 한단다. 도와준 친구에게는 더욱 그렇지.
lines.en: A promise must be kept. Even more so to a friend who helped you.
segs: A promise must be kept. Even more so to a friend who helped you.

lines.text: …알겠어요, 아버지.
lines.en: ...Yes, Father.

lines.text: 공주는 개구리를 식탁으로 데려갔어요.
lines.en: The princess brought the frog to the table.
segs: The princess brought the frog to the table.

lines.text: 약속했으니까 같이 먹자.
lines.en: I promised, so let's eat together.
segs: I promised, so let's eat together.

lines.text: 접시에 빵이 몇 개일까요? 접시를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: How many buns are on the plate? Tap the plate!
segs: How many buns are on the plate? Tap the plate!

lines.text: 빵이 세 개! 너 하나, 나 하나, 남은 하나는 나눠 먹자.
lines.en: Three buns! One for you, one for me, and we'll share the last one.
segs: Three buns! One for you, one for me, and we'll share the last one.

lines.text: 냠냠, 맛있다!
lines.en: Yum yum, delicious!

lines.text: 밤이 되자 개구리가 공주의 방까지 따라왔어요.
lines.en: When night came, the frog followed the princess all the way to her room.
segs: When night came, the frog followed the princess all the way to her room.

lines.text: 공주님, 같은 침대에서 자기로 했잖아요.
lines.en: Princess, you said I could sleep in your bed.
segs: Princess, you said I could sleep in your bed.

lines.text: 으, 이제 그만!
lines.en: Ugh, that's enough!

lines.text: 공주는 개구리를 침대 쪽으로 휙 던졌어요. 개구리는 푹신한 베개 위에 포옥!
lines.en: The princess tossed the frog toward the bed. Plop! He landed softly on the fluffy pillow!
segs: The princess tossed the frog toward the bed. Plop! He landed softly on the fluffy pillow!

lines.text: 고마워요. 나는 마법에 걸린 왕자였어요. 약속을 지켜 줘서 마법이 풀렸어요.
lines.en: Thank you. I was a prince under a spell. Because you kept your promise, the spell is broken.
segs: Thank you. I was a prince under a spell. Because you kept your promise, the spell is broken.

lines.text: 어머, 개구리가… 왕자님이었구나!
lines.en: Oh my, the frog... was a prince!
segs: Oh my, the frog... was a prince!

lines.text: 다음 날, 공주와 왕자는 성 뜰에서 함께 놀았어요.
lines.en: The next day, the princess and the prince played together in the castle garden.
segs: The next day, the princess and the prince played together in the castle garden.

lines.text: 이제 우리는 진짜 친구예요.
lines.en: Now we are true friends.

lines.text: 응! 우리 같이 공놀이하자!
lines.en: Yes! Let's play ball together!

lines.text: 둘은 금공을 주고받으며 오래오래 사이좋게 지냈답니다.
lines.en: And the two of them tossed the golden ball back and forth and were the best of friends for a long, long time.
segs: And the two of them tossed the golden ball back and forth and were the best of friends for a long, long time.

What shape is the golden ball? Pick one!
How many buns are on the plate? Tap the plate!
